desc: Treat yourself to the breakfast of champions with Cookie Crisp cereal! Deliciously shaped like cookies and bursting with chocolate chip flavor, Cookie Crisp provides 14g whole grain, 12 vitamins and minerals, calcium, and an excellent source of Vitamin D per serving. Start their day off sweet and enjoy the natural flavors in a bowl with milk or make it extra special by dunking each delicious cookie-like bite into the milk! (And don't worry...you can feel good about this sweet treat!)
features:
Cookie-shaped cereal with real chocolate chip flavor

Made with whole grain corn (at least 14g per serving)

Fortified with 12 vitamins and minerals including Vitamin D, B6, B12, Iron & Zinc

No high fructose corn syrup

Kosher certified

Perfect for breakfast or snacking
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Corn Meal, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Brown Sugar Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Corn Flour, Corn Syrup, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Annatto Extract Color, Rosemary Extract, Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (Mineral Nutrients), A B Vitamin (Niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (Thiamin Mononitrate), Vitamin A (Palmitate), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), A B Vitamin (Folic Acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
